name: Shuu Mariko
source:
A 2nd year university student. She’s currently active as a model and appears in magazines from time to time.

It’s unthinkable for a university student to join the club—or at least, it should be—but “If she’s a model, she’s bound to look great in costumes,” thought Rin, and through her forceful recruitment, she was dragged into the “Cosplay Club.”

After that, for some reason, Mariko didn’t quit like the other members, and she’s remained in the club ever since.

She is expressionless and impassive, making it impossible for others to guess what she’s thinking. At the Western-style mansion, she dresses up as a maid just like Rin, following Rin’s orders.

[From [url=https://hadashi.product.co.jp/oshioki/char05.html]official site[/url]]
